quote: In moments of crisis, panic does nothing. Harness it, let it serve you.
Fate only binds you if you let it.
Do what is necessary, not because it is written.
We make our own choices. Nothing more.
A god’s purpose is whatever he decides.
The choices you make define you more than the gods ever will.
Wisdom grows from scars earned, not words spoken.
Patience is a warrior’s greatest ally.
A calm mind cuts deeper than any blade.
The mind must be sharpened as often as the blade.
Death can have me when it earns me.
War is not a joke. Especially where gods are concerned.
I have killed gods greater than him.
Every path I walk leads back to vengeance.
I do not fear you.
Rage is a fire—use it, or be consumed by it.
A warrior who hesitates invites death.
Steel speaks clearly when words fail.
Victory is earned through resolve, not fury alone.
Strength without purpose is destruction.
You feel their pain because that is who you are. Never sacrifice that.
I will be no one's monster. Never again.
The boy is not ready.
I have been a warrior all my life. But I have never been a father until now.
Close your heart to it.
A father’s duty is endless, even when his strength is not.
Guidance is not control; it is a lantern in darkness.
I walk ahead so my son may walk safely behind.
A child’s heart must be protected, but never caged.
Strength means nothing if it cannot shield those you love.
I came to these lands to escape my past. To start a new life. I can hide no longer.
Your path is your own. It always has been.
The cycle ends here. We must be better.
Be glad you have a home to remember fondly. In Sparta, we were taken from our homes as children.
I do not seek war... but if Odin has stolen my son, do not doubt the lengths I will go to.
The past is a shadow; I choose the shape it casts.
Destiny is a chain only if you refuse to break it.
I am not who I was, but I carry him still.
A name means nothing without the deeds behind it.
The future is forged by the choices of today.
